3010000121111232222333103202130 - ASI: 26

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  03 = 0 * 3
  11 = 1 * 1
  12 = 1 * 2
  20 = 2 * 0
  21 = 2 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  23 = 2 * 3
  30 = 3 * 0
  31 = 3 * 1
  33 = 3 * 3
  301 = 30 * 1
  0000 = 00 * 00
  0320 = 03 * 20
  1123 = 11 * 23
  1211 = 12 * 11
  2130 = 21 * 30
  2222 = 22 * 22
  3331 = 33 * 31
  3010000 = 301 * 0000
  03202130 = 0320 * 2130
  12111123 = 1211 * 1123
  22223331 = 2222 * 3331
  301000012111123 = 3010000 * 12111123
  2222333103202130 = 22223331 * 03202130
  3010000121111232222333103202130 = 301000012111123 * 2222333103202130
